policies.evidence: saved per-invocation gcov artifacts only; no API/COBOL/gcov reruns
policies.admissibility: inadmissible cases are reported with reasons and never counted as zero coverage
policies.sourceAlignment: line/branch IDs are unioned only within the same business program and source-file SHA-256
policies.mainUnit: only correctedParser.mainGeneratedC .gcov is used; generated headers/helpers are excluded
policies.branchDefinitions: branch IDs preserve gcov line number + branch index; executed means not 'never executed'; taken means taken > 0
